system.description:
Gargoyles were bred to guard chantries and havens, and this power lets you monitor an entire building without patrolling it. By touching the structure, you gain an innate sense of its layout, hidden passages, and the location, size, and condition of everyone and everything inside.

Spend a Willpower Trait to activate. You must maintain continuous skin contact and active concentration, though you may move slowly while doing so. The building must contain a substantial amount of stone or concrete; the power cannot reveal conversations or what someone is holding, and Obfuscated Kindred register only as an indistinct blur.
